title: Urutonde rwo kwisuzuma – Umutima, amaraso n'ibihaha
subject: Biologi
intro: Hano ushobora kwitoza ibiruta ibindi ku mutima, amaraso n'ibihaha. Tangirira ku by'ibanze, hanyuma ukomeze ugana ku bumenyi bwimbitse.

sections.title: Inzira z'ubuhumekero
items: Nzi ko umwenge w'izuru utoba, ushyushya kandi ugasukura umwuka duhumeka neza kurusha umunwa.
Nshobora kuvuga ibice by'inzira z'ubuhumekero uko bikurikirana: izuru/umunwa → umuhogo → larynx (agasanduku k'ijwi) → trachea → bronchi → alveoli (udufuka tw'umwuka).
Nzi ko trachea ifunguwe n'impeta z'igufwa ryoroshye (karitilaje).
Nshobora gusobanura uko cilia (imisatsi mito) n'ururenda birinda ibihaha umukungugu n'umwanda.
Nshobora gusobanura icyo imigozi y'ijwi ari cyo n'uko ikora amajwi.

sections.title: Ibihaha no guhumeka
items: Nzi ko alveoli (udufuka tw'umwuka) tuzengurutswe n'imitsi mito y'amaraso aho gaze zihererekanyirizwa.
Nshobora gusobanura ko ibihaha bifite ubuso bunini cyane (hafi 80 m²) bitewe na miliyoni z'udufuka tw'umwuka.
Nshobora gusobanura guhumeka ukoresheje inda: uko diaphragme izamuka ikamanuka nka piston y'ipombo y'igare.
Nzi ko dushobora guhumeka dukoresheje diaphragme (guhumeka ukoresheje inda) no gukoresha imitsi y'imbavu (guhumeka ukoresheje igituza).
Nzi ko umubare wo guhumeka wiyongera uva ku 12–15 mu munota ukiruhutse ukagera hafi kuri 60 mu kazi gakomeye.

sections.title: Imitsi y'amaraso
items: Nshobora gusobanura itandukaniro hagati ya arteri (ziva ku mutima, zifite inkuta zibyibushye), veine (zijya ku mutima, zifite valvule) na kapilere (zoroheje, guhererekanya gaze).
Nzi ko aorta ari yo arteri nini mu mubiri kandi ivana amaraso muri ventrikuli y'ibumoso.
Nshobora gusobanura impamvu veine zifite valvule (zibuza amaraso gusubira inyuma).
Nzi ko imitsi y'umubiri ifasha amaraso gutembera imbere muri veine.
Nzi ko pulse ari umuhengeri w'igitutu mu arteri kuri buri gutera k'umutima.

sections.title: Umutima
items: Nzi ko umutima ufite ibyumba bine: atriyumu y'iburyo n'iy'ibumoso, na ventrikuli y'iburyo n'iy'ibumoso.
Nshobora gusobanura inzira amaraso anyuramo mu byumba bine by'umutima.
Nzi ko umutima urimo valvule (iz'ishusho y'ubwato n'iz'ishusho y'umufuka) zibuza amaraso gusubira inyuma.
Nzi ko arteri z'umutima (arteri koronari) zitanga oksijeni n'intungamubiri ku mitsi y'umutima.
Nzi ko pulse yo kuruhuka iri hafi ya 70 kandi ishobora kugabanuka ikajya munsi ya 40 ku bantu bakora imyitozo cyane.
Nshobora gusobanura icyo umuvuduko w'amaraso ari cyo n'agaciro gasanzwe ku ngimbi n'abangavu (hafi 120/80).

sections.title: Uruzinduko rw'amaraso rubiri
items: Nshobora gusobanura uruzinduko ruto: amaraso afite oksijeni nke → ventrikuli y'iburyo → ibihaha → atriyumu y'ibumoso.
Nshobora gusobanura uruzinduko runini: amaraso afite oksijeni nyinshi → ventrikuli y'ibumoso → aorta → umubiri → atriyumu y'iburyo.
Nzi ko amaraso afite oksijeni nyinshi atukura yerurutse, naho afite oksijeni nke agatukura yijimye.
Nshobora gusobanura impamvu uruzinduko rw'amaraso rwitwa rubiri.

sections.title: Ibigize amaraso
items: Nshobora kuvuga ibice bine by'amaraso: uturemangingo dutukura, uturemangingo twera, platelet na plasma.
Nzi ko uturemangingo dutukura tudafite nucleus kandi dutwara oksijeni dukoresheje hemoglobine.
Nzi ko hemoglobine irimo icyuma (fer) kandi ko kubura fer bishobora gutera anemiya.
Nshobora gusobanura uko platelet n'imigozi ya fibrine bikora igikonjo ku gisebe bigahagarika kuva amaraso.
Nzi ko plasma igizwe n'amazi arimo ibintu bishonze nk'umunyu, imisemburo, glukoze na proteyine.
Nzi icyo ingano ya hemoglobine mu maraso isobanura (garama za hemoglobine muri litiro imwe y'amaraso) n'agaciro gasanzwe.

sections.title: Ibisukura amaraso mu mubiri
items: Nshobora gusobanura icyo lymph ari cyo n'uko imitsi ya lymph n'udusabo twa lymph bikora.
Nzi ko umwijima usukura amaraso uyakuramo uburozi, ugakora indurwe, kandi ugahindura amoniyaki ure.
Nzi ko impyiko zisuzuma amaraso zigakora inkari zirimo ure n'imyunyu.
Nzi ko umuntu ashobora kubaho afite impyiko imwe kandi ko dialyse ari ugusukura amaraso hakoreshejwe imashini.

sections.title: Umuvuduko wo guhumeka no guhumeka kw'utugari
items: Nzi ko ubwonko bugenzura guhumeka mu buryo bwikora bupima ingano ya dioksidi ya kaboni mu maraso.
Nshobora gusobanura isano: gukora cyane → guhumeka kw'utugari kwinshi → dioksidi ya kaboni nyinshi → guhumeka vuba.
Nzi ko guhumeka vuba cyane (hyperventilation) bigabanya dioksidi ya kaboni kandi bishobora gutuma guhagarika umwuka mu mazi bibangamira ubuzima.

sections.title: Uruzinduko rw'amaraso mu nyamaswa zifite umugongo
items: Nzi ko amafi afite uruzinduko rw'amaraso rumwe n'umutima ufite ibyumba 2 (atriyumu 1 + ventrikuli 1).
Nzi ko inyamaswa zibaho mu mazi no ku butaka n'ibikururuka bifite uruzinduko rubiri n'umutima ufite ibyumba 3 – ariko amaraso avangirwa muri ventrikuli.
Nzi ko inyoni n'inyamabere bifite uruzinduko rubiri n'umutima ufite ibyumba 4 – amaraso ntavangwa.
Nshobora gusobanura impamvu inyamaswa zifite ubushyuhe buhoraho zikeneye uruzinduko rw'amaraso rukora neza kurusha izifite ubushyuhe buhinduka.

sections.title: Ubwoko bw'amaraso na Rh factor
items: Nshobora gusobanura ko ubwoko bw'amaraso bugenwa n'ibintu (A na/cyangwa B) biri hejuru y'uturemangingo dutukura.
Nzi antibodies ziboneka muri buri bwoko bw'amaraso (A: anti-B, B: anti-A, AB: nta, 0: anti-A na anti-B).
Nshobora gusobanura impamvu guterwa amaraso adahuje ubwoko ari bibi (uturemangingo dutukura duhurira hamwe).
Nzi ko ubwoko bwa 0 bushobora guhabwa abantu bose kandi ko AB ishobora kwakira ubwoko bwose.
Nzi icyo Rh factor ari cyo n'uko ufite Rh-negatifu adakwiye guterwa amaraso ya Rh-pozitifu.

sections.title: Ingano ya hemoglobine na doping
items: Nzi ko imyitozo ikorerwa ahantu hirengeye yongera umubare w'uturemangingo dutukura kugira ngo bisimbure umwuka woroshye.
Nshobora gusobanura uko doping y'amaraso ikorwa n'impamvu ibujijwe.
Nzi ko EPO ari umusemburo ukorwa n'impyiko kandi ugenzura ikorwa ry'uturemangingo dutukura.
Nzi ko doping y'amaraso na doping ya EPO bituma amaraso arushaho kubyimba, bigatuma ibyago byo gufatana kw'amaraso mu mitsi (blood clot) byiyongera.
